scope: Full unrecorded source and production brief, renderer mechanism, and final polished native still samples listed below. No continuous playback, measured voice or human listening.

assumptions: Generic flowering-plant anatomy, not strawberry flower anatomy.
Pollen is distinct from sperm. Compatible pollen grows a tube that delivers nonmotile sperm near the egg.

One sperm joins the egg and the fertilised egg develops into an embryo. Ovule develops into seed. The other fertilisation and endosperm are explicitly deferred in author notes; this lesson does not claim a complete angiosperm mechanism.
The stopped-tube task supplies one ovule and excludes every alternative tube to that ovule. It asks about the selected embryo-forming route, not all possible plant reproduction.

studentLearningReview.entryKnowledge: Plants have cells; prior lessons introduced reproduction and sperm/egg joining. No meiosis or chromosome knowledge is needed.
studentLearningReview.mainQuestion: Why does pollen arrival need a route to the egg before an embryo can form?
studentLearningReview.trace: Egg inside ovule inside ovary; pollen reaches stigma; tube bridges the physical distance; sperm travels inside; sperm joins egg; fertilised egg develops into embryo; ovule becomes seed. The stopped-tube case tests the broken link.
retainedSuccesses: Necessary flower terms have plain meanings and visible locations.
Physical separation earns the pollen-tube explanation.
Embryo is distinguished from the whole seed.
Feedback explains why arrival alone is insufficient.
Notes occur after explanation with a quiet copy hold.

memoryAid.status: scientifically sound within this selected flowering-plant route
memoryAid.reason: After explanation, it recalls stigma arrival and egg joining as separate physical landmarks and helps solve a stopped-tube case. It does not assert every pollen arrival succeeds.

resolvedFindings.resolution: Displayed third demand now says Explain whether this egg can develop into an embryo. It retains causal justification, is equivalent within the selected route, and fits in native attempt910.
